hook.text: Paul Ekman discovered that real emotions flash across your face in 1/25th of a second. Most people miss them.

buildup.text: These micro-expressions are involuntary. Even trained liars cannot suppress them. The face leaks the truth briefly.

discovery.text: Seven universal emotions show on every human face: happiness, sadness, anger, fear, surprise, disgust, and contempt.

twist.text: Micro-Expressions has a twist: the obvious interpretation usually breaks down.

climax.text: Watch for the flash that does not match the words. A brief grimace during 'I am fine' is worth a gentle follow-up.

punchline.text: The face speaks first. Words come second.

quiz.question: What does a micro-expression reveal?
options: A brief flash of true emotion that may differ from what is displayed
